note: Identity of every opponent arm for the evidence rows (schema v2 in agent_paper.md). artifact_bytes counts the model files the runtime opens.

zen2.hardware: AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 3995WX (xbabe0), pinned physical cores, arm alone on its CCX, SMT siblings idle

xeon8358.hardware: Intel Xeon Platinum 8358, AVX-512 VNNI (xbabe6, 30-vCPU cloud VM; pinned vCPUs 20-28, topology hidden by the hypervisor)

m3ultra.hardware: Apple M3 Ultra (xbabe4, macOS 26.5; no CPU affinity, thread count only)

jsr-d2e-int8.configuration: prepared INT8, greedy, 160 ms chunks, no lookahead, 20 ms packets

jsr-d2e-int8-enginetool.configuration: prepared INT8, greedy, 160 ms chunks, no lookahead, 20 ms packets; the engine's own tool (the only form that builds on macOS)

zipformer-int8.configuration: int8, greedy, 320 ms chunks, 20 ms packets, 0.8 s tail padding

zipformer-int8-sherpapy.configuration: int8, greedy, 320 ms chunks, 20 ms packets, 0.8 s tail padding; same library and bundle as the Rust service

moonshine-tiny.runtime: Moonshine Voice SDK 0.1.6 (ONNX Runtime, one thread)
moonshine-tiny.configuration: quantised streaming bundle, 20 ms packets, transcript update every 200 ms

parakeet-redux.configuration: ternary encoder weights, whole utterance, one utterance at a time
parakeet-redux.hold: kestrel-kernels ships under a proprietary licence that requires a separate written agreement; owner review pending

parakeet-unified-offline.configuration: Q8_0, greedy RNN-T, whole utterance, full attention

parakeet-unified-stream160.configuration: Q8_0, greedy RNN-T, buffered streaming: left 5.6 s / chunk 80 ms / right 80 ms, left context re-encoded every chunk

nemotron-labs-unified-offline.configuration: FP32, greedy label-looping RNN-T, language prompt en, whole utterance, one utterance per batch

nemotron-labs-unified-stream160.system: Nemotron Labs Unified ASR 0.6B (160 ms mode)
nemotron-labs-unified-stream160.configuration: FP32, greedy label-looping RNN-T, language prompt en, buffered streaming: left 5.6 s / chunk 80 ms / right 80 ms, full buffer re-encoded every chunk

nemotron-labs-unified-stream160-batch16.system: Nemotron Labs Unified ASR 0.6B (160 ms mode, accuracy pass)
nemotron-labs-unified-stream160-batch16.configuration: the 160 ms buffered loop with sixteen utterances side by side; accuracy pass, never a timed row
